name: Secrets the computer cannot read
what: You enter a secret in Silo's own prompt, outside any chat, and the computer gets only its name and a placeholder. Silo's network stack swaps in the real value only on the way to the hosts you allowed, so the real value never enters the computer or the record. A request to a model provider stays byte for byte the same apart from the swap, so its prompt cache still hits.

suggest.why: A secret that never enters the computer cannot be read, printed or sent anywhere by an agent, which no rule inside the computer can promise.
